rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Reviewer abandonment leaves many failed agentic PRs without meaningful human engagement.
rationale.quality-debt: Mined PRs exhibit CI failures, incorrect implementations, incompleteness, and invasive changes.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Repository CI and tests provide grounded validation affecting merge outcomes.
rationale.hitl-workflow: The study characterizes human review comments, revisions, rejection, and merge decisions.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Agents submit unwanted, duplicate, misdirected changes and disregard reviewer instructions.
rationale.agentic: Autonomous coding agents deliver repository-level pull requests for maintainer review.
rationale.risk-quality: Empirically measures quality failures including broken tests and incorrect implementations.
rationale.risk-ip: Reports licensing and ownership violations among rejected agent-generated contributions.
rationale.method-mining: Quantitatively and qualitatively mines 33,596 real GitHub pull requests.
